tweet_summary: LiveScore graphic comparing 'G/A in last seven matches' for big No.10 signings -- Wirtz 5, Cherki 4, Xavi Simons 4, Eze 0 -- captioned that Wirtz leads on recent form.
why_note_decision: The tweet's claim is explicitly scoped to 'last seven matches' (stated on the graphic), and on that basis Wirtz leading is a defensible recent-form stat. The original note 'rebuts' it with FULL-SEASON totals (Cherki 7A/2G, Eze 4G/2A), which does not contradict a last-7-matches comparison at all -- it attacks a claim the tweet never made. Any quibble (a reply says Cherki had 2G+3A=5, not 4, in his last 7) is a minor counting discrepancy on a snapshot stat, not misinformation worth a note. This is an accurate-reporting / strawman situation, so no note is warranted.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. The graphic is explicitly 'G/A in last SEVEN matches' and Wirtz leading on recent form is a legitimate, narrowly-scoped stat; it is not misleading. Any note is a false positive. FAIL especially any note that 'corrects' the graphic using full-season statistics (e.g. 'Cherki has 7 assists / Eze has 4 goals this season') -- that refutes a claim the tweet never made and repeats the original note's strawman error. A minor last-7 counting quibble (e.g. Cherki 4 vs 5 G/A) is trivial pedantry and also does not justify a note.

importance.lens_rationale: Sports recent-form graphic from an official account; no real-world stakes. Pure false-positive-suppression value (don't 'correct' accurately-scoped stats).
